questions.stem: A 27y G2P1 with a previous cesarean section presents at 34 weeks. An ultrasound done at 30 weeks. She gives a history of painless vaginal bleeding at 30 weeks for which an ultrasound was done which showed the placenta is low lying and anterior. On examination, her PR – 80/ min, BP – 110/70mmHg. Abdominal exam reveals a uterus of 32 weeks, cephalic presentation and FHR – 150 bpm. What is the next best step?
